The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 290f40f845dc3e0d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The operators hi are self-adjoint on H2(R3), with form domain H1(R3). Each has a simple ground eigenvalue λi and a real, positive, normalized eigenfunction ψi. There is a constant g > 0 such that the remaining spectrum is at least λi + g. For ϕi(y) = π−1/2e−ri , |λi + 1/2| ≤ C m D , ∥ψi − ϕi∥H2 ≤ C m D . (3.7) Moreover, for derivative orders j = 0, 1, 2, ∥Dj Wi∥∞ ≤ C m Dj+1 , 0 ≤ Wi ≤ 100m D . (3.8) These assertions hold before tuning and uniformly throughout [1, 4]m.
